name: gymbot
description: AI workout coach. The app runs as a single-file Claude.ai artifact; this repo adds the web shell, a Python backend for the hosted copy, and tests.

scripts.dev: npm run build -- --watch=forever & uv run python -m server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/e2e/workout.test.mjs tests/e2e/activities.test.mjs tests/e2e/coach.test.mjs tests/e2e/data.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e
